checks.command: synthetic deterministic backup; 302 truncations and 150 one-byte mutations; verify_backup on each
checks.name: malformed_zip_fuzz
reproduction: Truncate the valid archive to 907 bytes (one byte before EOCD) or 906 bytes; verify_backup raises struct.error from _inspect_zip_container local-header unpacking.
Flip one byte in the manifest local-header name (offsets 26..97 in this fixture); verify_backup raises zipfile.BadZipFile from archive.infolist() instead of returning LIGHT_BACKUP_INVALID.

findings.evidence: Truncated deterministic archive reaches local-header struct.unpack_from after only local_off + 30 is checked; a 907-byte archive raises struct.error instead of a closed LIGHT_BACKUP_INVALID result.
findings.required_fix: Bounds-check local-header name/extra spans and catch malformed struct/bounds paths so every malformed container closes with LIGHT_BACKUP_INVALID or documented ResearchError.
findings.title: Malformed ZIP inputs can escape as struct.error

findings.evidence: A one-byte mutation of a valid local-header member name passes _inspect_zip_container, then archive.infolist() raises zipfile.BadZipFile; _open_zip catches only constructor-time BadZipFile.
findings.required_fix: Treat infolist/open/read BadZipFile and malformed metadata as closed LIGHT_BACKUP_INVALID results; retain bounded reads and no partial restore.
findings.title: zipfile.BadZipFile escapes during infolist parsing

scope_statement: Read-only review; no production source, tests, Git state, real PDFs, real Vault, or external data were mutated.
